hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */README.md|README.md|*/CLAUDE.md|CLAUDE.md) exit 0 ;; esac; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Reminder: Check if README.md or CLAUDE.md needs to be updated to reflect this change."}}'; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */pyproject.toml|pyproject.toml) uv sync 2>&1 ;; esac; }
